subject: Fire-rate backoff + configurable cadence for headless drains (no API hammering under overload)
description:
Per note:note-mqgztj9lza0: the drain governor has NO rate-limit/overload backoff and an aggressive HARDCODED 5-min, per-eager-node cadence, which amplified an Anthropic API overload this session. Add to lib/headless-drain.js (+ daemon.js trigger). Branch off main; flat task; keep ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS default-OFF and all non-throttled behavior unchanged.

(1) RATE-LIMIT/OVERLOAD BACKOFF (the key fix): detect when a drain spawn's result indicates throttling/overload — parse runDrain's stdout/stderr/exit for 429 / 529 / "overloaded" / "rate limit" / stream-json error events. Track it in governor state (e.g. consecutiveThrottles + backoffUntil). When tripped, BACK OFF exponentially: runDueDrains checks backoffUntil at the top and no-ops (skipped:'backoff') until it passes; the backoff window grows per consecutive throttle (cap it), and RESETS to zero on a clean successful run. So drains retreat under load instead of firing every tick into an overload.

(2) CONFIGURABLE CADENCE: lift the hardcoded 5-min setInterval in daemon.js (~L2205) into an env-configurable interval (HEADLESS_DRAIN_INTERVAL_MS) with a conservative default (~15 min) + small random jitter so ticks don't align.

(3) PER-TICK EAGER CAP: cap the number of judge claude -p spawns in a SINGLE runDueDrains tick (a new env like HEADLESS_DRAIN_MAX_PER_TICK, small default e.g. 2) — distinct from maxIterations (per-boot) — so a burst of new nodes can't fire many claude -p back-to-back in one tick.

TESTS (test/headless-drain.test.js): backoff trips on a simulated throttle/overload spawn result and skips subsequent ticks until the window passes, then resumes; a clean run resets the backoff; cadence env is respected; per-tick eager cap is enforced. Keep the suite green. ACCEPTANCE: drains demonstrably back off under a simulated 429/529; cadence + per-tick cap configurable with conservative defaults; no behavior change when not throttled; flag stays default-off.
